keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria files this state's shapes under 'Grand Duchy of Würzburg' 1811-1814, per the eu-20-g notes). The infobox gives 5,160 km2 and 302,000 people; the gazetteer's five discs at Aschaffenburg (19 km), Frankfurt, Hanau, Wetzlar (14 km) and Fulda (24 km) come to about 5,060 km2 (ratio 0.98). The page names only the five centres, no boundary.

ledger.note: 16 February 1810: Napoleon creates the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt for Dalberg. Infobox 'Established: 16 February 1810'; 'Dalberg was forced by Napoleon to relinquish his Principality of Regensburg to the Kingdom of Bavaria' and his 'remaining territories of Aschaffenburg, Wetzlar, Fulda, Hanau, and Frankfurt were combined into the new Grand Duchy of Frankfurt'.

1810: Hanau is combined into the grand duchy (with Fulda), 'Aschaffenburg, Wetzlar, Fulda, Hanau, and Frankfurt were combined'. The page gives no separate date or former owner for Hanau; the Hesse-Cassel counterpart is from the electorate-of-hesse dossier.
1810: Fulda is combined into the grand duchy. The page gives no separate date or former owner for Fulda; the French counterpart is from the first-french-empire and electorate-of-hesse dossiers.

Later fates are not dated on the page: Frankfurt a free city, 'most of the territory ... ultimately annexed by the Kingdom of Bavaria'.

notes: New dossier, a state Cliopatria lacks (Cliopatria files its shape under the 'Grand Duchy of Würzburg' row 1811-1814 according to the eu-20-g notes; the grand-duchy-of-wurzburg dossier is theirs). Dalberg's abdication of 26 October 1813 is in the rulers strip only (the ledger has no ruler-change type). The five territories are discs around towns (Aschaffenburg, Hanau and Wetzlar are not in the gazetteer, so coordinates are used) sized to the infobox area 5,160 km2; the real outline was the Main and Lahn lands plus Fulda and Hanau. The page says most of the territory went to Bavaria; the electorate-of-hesse and kingdom-of-bavaria dossiers date Hanau 1813, Fulda 1815 and Aschaffenburg 1814, none of which this page states. Dalberg's old title (Prince-Primate of the Confederation of the Rhine) and Regensburg are not on this page beyond the transfer of Regensburg to Bavaria. Gazetteer names needed: Aschaffenburg, Hanau, Wetzlar (places).
